method: Version 12 notes rewritten under the Study Studio balanced-length guidance (about 100-150 words for simple pages, 175-250 for standard concepts, 250-300 for experiments and detailed mechanisms, and up to 350 only for especially complex pages, averaging about 225). Repeated restatements and closing summaries that add no new fact are removed, long sentences are split into shorter spoken sentences, and every source term, value, study, stimulus and figure detail stays. Notes keep bolded main bullets of connected sentences with nested sub-bullets, direct explanations, and no presentation narration, arrow chains, colons or semicolons, added topics, padding of titles or logistics, or references to other pages. Matching review pages reuse the lecture notes, and review page 54 is authored separately.
